purpose: Ingest and no-return screen one management earnings-forecast disclosure mechanism for the fixed three-session A-share protocol without sweeping forecast fields, types, formulas, directions, event ages, symbols, dates, prices, or returns.

source_selection.standard_interface_scope: The standard forecast endpoint can retrieve one stock's history; the forecast_vip all-market quarterly route requires 5000 points and is forbidden.
source_selection.why_this_source: A dated management earnings forecast is an issuer expectation event, not a realized income/cashflow statement version, historical price transform, analyst report, ownership event, or order-flow field.

mechanism_identity.economic_mechanism: Among forecasts whose percentage-growth scale is economically comparable, a higher announced midpoint of attributable-net-profit year-on-year change may be incorporated over the next three sessions.
mechanism_identity.relationship_to_quarterly_quality: Realized ROE, revenue growth, profit growth, and their accelerations remain quality eligibility or uniqueness context only. The candidate uses a dated management forecast and must pass a no-return near-synonym screen before any return access.
mechanism_identity.relationship_to_terminal_cash_conversion: This candidate uses forecast percentage bounds and announcement dates only; it requests no income/cashflow statement metric, comp_type, report_type, f_ann_date, or statement-version field.

source.request_mode: one stock and one frozen announcement-date range per call

point_in_time_and_version_policy.first_announcement_date_role: first_ann_date is audit context only. A missing first_ann_date is counted but does not move availability; a complete value must be no later than ann_date.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.unknown_type_policy: Any non-missing type outside the frozen eight-type catalog aborts the stock partition; missing type is a fatal key error.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.range_policy: Both p_change_min and p_change_max must be finite for a comparable type and p_change_min must be no greater than p_change_max. Otherwise exclude and count the event; never swap, fill, clip, or infer bounds from type.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.duplicate_policy: For one instrument, ann_date, and report period, exact seven-field semantic duplicates may be counted and collapsed. Any differing tuple for the same event key aborts the partition.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.same_instrument_announcement_multi_perio: If one instrument has more than one retained report period on the same ann_date, exclude every such event before capacity; never select the latest or largest change.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.conservative_availability: first local trading session strictly after ann_date
point_in_time_and_version_policy.residual_risk: Tushare exposes ann_date and first_ann_date but no exchange release timestamp or explicit revision sequence. Next-session availability and collision exclusion reduce, but cannot eliminate, vendor revision-history risk.

factor.name: tushare_earnings_forecast_growth_midpoint
factor.units: percentage points of forecast attributable-net-profit year-on-year change
factor.excluded_type_policy: 扭亏, 首亏, and 续亏 do not share a monotonic percentage-growth scale with profitable comparable states and remain missing rather than receiving an ordinal score.
factor.nonfinite_derived_value_policy: exclude and count; never offset or impute
factor.absent_event_policy: missing; never treat a missing or non-comparable forecast as zero

required_checks_before_full_sync: the environment supplies TUSHARE_TOKEN without logging its value
exactly one forecast request is issued for each frozen symbol and no other symbol or date range
each response contains exactly the frozen seven-field whitelist and remains below the local 100-row truncation-suspicion ceiling
stock, announcement date, report period, and type keys are complete and every returned stock matches its request
report periods are standard quarter ends and announcement dates fall within the frozen request range
only the five comparable types may produce a midpoint; the three loss-state transition types are excluded and counted
unknown types and conflicting duplicate event keys abort acceptance; exact semantic duplicates alone may collapse
finite ordered percentage bounds reproduce the local midpoint exactly
at least two frozen symbols retain a comparable event and the total source response contains at least six rows
no credential, forbidden forecast narrative or amount field, statement field, price, score, or return appears in a published frame or manifest
acceptance_protocol.failed_acceptance_policy: write one no-return rejection record and stop without another symbol or date range, field/type relaxation, full sync, capacity, uniqueness, price access, formula or direction change, score, selection, sizing, orders, or Level-2 justification
acceptance_protocol.one_shot_policy: The exact contract may publish at most one terminal success or rejection record.

full_snapshot_contract.provider_call_partition: one ts_code over the full frozen announcement-date range

uniqueness.comparison_scope: all 54 frozen close-known or historical mechanism fields used by the terminal cash-conversion preregistration plus explicit quarterly quality growth level and acceleration composites

no_return_gates.failed_gate_policy: stop without returns, loss-state ordinal mapping, another forecast field or formula, direction inversion, event-age widening, lower capacity or synonym threshold, year/type/industry subset, rejected-factor combination, current scoring, selection, sizing, orders, or Level-2 intake
